_comment: Contract for the SessionStart hook payload fixtures in this directory.
validates every fixture on EVERY run - no agent binary and no opt-in
required. Child t1705_3 consumes these fixtures unconditionally, so their
presence, shape, status and redaction must be proved by a normal run and
not only by the opt-in real-agent lane that refreshes them.
A single 'required keys' rule cannot be right for all three outcomes this
spike can legitimately reach: a proven-unsupported agent has no payload to
carry, and an inconclusive probe must not masquerade as a settled contract.
Hence three statuses with DIFFERENT required and forbidden fields.

captured.meaning: A real, authoritative payload captured from the production (interactive) launch path. This is the only status children 3 and 5 may treat as a settled contract.

unsupported.meaning: The agent provably has no SessionStart hook: the positive control passed, a config surface was demonstrably accepted and trusted, and no payload was delivered. This is the ONLY status that may pin a capability limit into the parent plan.

provisional.meaning: Inconclusive - neither authoritative nor disproved. Payload keys MAY be present but are non-authoritative. Children 3 and 5 must not treat this agent's schema as settled.

_comment: Fixtures are committed to a public repository. Redaction is asserted on
every run, not only when a fixture is refreshed.
